extracted.name: Chocolate chip cookies with m&m's
extracted.description: I honestly didn't count the cookies but this is a roundabout amount. I just use a cookie scoop and scoop until the dough is gone.🤷🏼‍♀️
instruction_lines: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix in 1/2 flour mixture with butter and sugar mixture.
After it's well blended mix in the other half of flour mixture
Fold in 1 cup of chocolate chips
Chill cookie dough for 30 minutes in fridge.
Let cookies rest 5 minutes before transferring to cooling rack.
